candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: complete transparent 2.5D pixel-art game object, state B AFTER CLEANING / BEFORE parts upgrade.
The supplied image is the exact identity and camera reference: one small closed square orange cardboard nesting parcel, four purple edging rails with golden brass riveted corner guards, an infinity-return symbol and two purple horizontal strokes on the front and top.
Render this SAME entire object at the SAME three-quarter viewpoint and proportions with identical warm upper-left light and fine dense pixel texture. The box has been cleaned, so its orange paper surfaces and original purple printing are clear. However it is still structurally damaged: the entire lid sits askew (slightly translated left and rotated around the rear hinge), leaving an uneven dark gap along the front seam; the front-left lower cardboard corner is clearly crushed inward and creased, and the left-front brass corner guard is slightly bent inward but remains attached. The paper body remains one connected coherent box, not separate floating pieces. No new handles, panels, jewels or text. Keep the original purple rails and brass guards, maintain the same angle, body size and object identity. Differences from final repaired box must be visible without labels, more than color brightness.
Output one COMPLETE standalone illustration, NO collage, no rectangular texture patches, no cut-up pixel fragment layers. Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no floor or cast shadow plane, no scene, cabinet, tools, hands, captions, border, aura or extra boxes floating outside. One square PNG with the entire object centered, about12 percent transparent margins. Match high-quality fine pixel illustration and dark purple outlines of the reference; do not make smooth vector art, large crude pixels, red/green/magenta edge fringes or photorealism.
candidates.rejectionReason: B1 softened the large crushed corner during cleaning. B2 preserves the large triangular dent, torn folds and uneven crooked-lid gap.

candidates.prompt:

Change ONLY surface contamination: remove the loose gray-brown dust, dirty smears and loose paper debris from the orange panels and seams; reveal the same aged orange cardboard and purple rails. Do not repaint or reconstruct the scuffed infinity symbols. Clean the brass without straightening its guards.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve EXACTLY the conspicuous large crushed inward dent and triangular creases at the bottom-left front cardboard corner. This is permanent structural damage, NOT dirt. The crushed region must stay the SAME SIZE, depth and torn-paper folds as in the input, not shrink to a shallow wrinkle. Preserve the worn/torn physical paper fibers of this corner. Preserve the same crooked shifted lid and long uneven dark front gap; it must NOT close, flatten, or become aligned. Preserve all bent purple edging, worn paint and attached corner fittings. Cleaning must not repair or upgrade anything. Keep the entire connected box, camera, projection, silhouette, placement, size, perspective, markings and warm light unchanged.
Render a coherent full standalone fine-pixel 2.5D game object with warm orange paper, dark-purple rails and gold guards, dark-purple outline. Do not paste rectangular cleaned patches, cut up the object, apply separate dots or add new parts. One COMPLETE image, not a collage. Genuinely transparent alpha background; no floor, scene, cast shadow plane, cabinet, glass, frame, tools, hands, labels, sparkle or other props. All original margins and framing retained.
